RELAY-27A is labelled UV BUS A, but only dashed control routing is visible near the relay; no solid tap from BUS-120AC-A is visible.
Dashed route/enclosure line approaches RELAY-27A and RPS-PNL-A, but no explicit solid terminal-to-terminal conductor is visible.
Lockout relay 86A is near the A-side RPS/control route, but the visible connection is dashed/routed rather than a definite electrical edge.

The buses meet only through CB-105, which is labelled N.O. and listed OPEN; terminal edges to CB-105 are asserted, but direct bus-to-bus continuity is not.
